{"sql":"SELECT account_code, account_name, period, amount_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance
WHERE account_type = 'opex'
AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
ORDER BY account_code, period","purpose":"List all OPEX accounts for Aug and Sep 2026"}
